admission.justification: Branch policy decided in two places that disagree produces worktrees nobody can reconcile, so it is durable only while the worktree tools (worktrees/source_lineage.py, reading the master's recorded execution nature) decide it and the bootstrap route (c-14 SKILL.md) restates no conflicting policy.

applicability: The worktree intent and branch policy that a light task or a bootstrap decides before work starts.
conditions: The recorded organizational or atomic nature of the work decides the branching, not a rule per master.
The worktree tools decide it from the master's recorded execution nature; no instruction text restates the policy.
exclusions: Creating a branch for every master by default.

evidence: a2/doctrine-review.md P6; criteria/doctrine.md D-4; core/authority.md:109–116; a2/retired-section-map.md.

statement: Worktree intent and branch policy follows recorded organizational versus atomic execution nature instead of creating a branch for every master.
